US-Iran Tensions Escalate, Impacting Global Markets and Shipping

Renewed hostilities between the US and Iran have led to a tanker strike in the Strait of Hormuz and new US military actions. These developments have caused global markets, including India's stock exchanges and consumer firms, to fall due to fears of rising oil prices and inflation. India has urged restraint and a return to dialogue amidst the escalating regional instability.
